records.body_text: Instamart is my go-to for weekly groceries. Same milk, bread, eggs every time. Never explored other categories.
Instamart personal care section feels overpriced. I only order snacks and drinks on Instamart.
Instamart grocery orders are fast but I stick to the same list. The reorder button makes it too easy.
Anyone else only use Instamart for groceries? I had no idea Instamart sells pet supplies until my neighbour mentioned it.
records.title: Instamart category discovery

records.body_text: Instamart search is bad for finding niche health products. Gave up and reordered dal instead.
